claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026
NASA's Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT
NASA's Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida
NASA's Artemis II mission sends four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon and back
NASA's Artemis II mission marks the first crewed flight to the Moon since 1972
The crew of NASA's Artemis II mission consists of Wiseman, Glover, Koch, and Hansen
The crew of NASA's Artemis II mission will test the Orion capsule before landing missions
The launch vehicle for NASA's Artemis II mission is the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket
NASA's Artemis II mission will last roughly 10 days
Splashdown for NASA's Artemis II mission is planned for April 10, 2026
According to the Adler Planetarium, if NASA's Artemis II mission was delayed from April 1, alternative launch windows were set for early April
